description.p: Butter manages Rosemary, a compatibility layer that runs macOS applications on Linux. It builds Rosemary releases into runners, and keeps each program in a bottle of its own: a Rosemary prefix with its own Darwin filesystem, settings and environment.

ul.li: Install the official build of any tagged Rosemary release, build it from source, or add your own build
Create bottles with a verified MiniDarwin base system
Run app bundles and Mach-O executables with one click
Choose native or emulated execution, titlebar and menu styles, and more
Verify, repair and update a bottle's system files

description.p: First release: runners built from source, bottles, and program launching.
